correctness.rationale: Kunz inequalities and exhaustive Apéry decomposition cases show leaf families A-D. Each of four explicitly described coordinate translations is positive, Kunz-admissible, genus-preserving and internal. Six arithmetic disjointness comparisons establish injection. Four exact one-parameter intervals give formula, and the 2018 total count gives asymptotics. Independent-from-formula minimal-generator enumeration checks genus 3..80; finite experiments are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An all-genus infinite-family proof of the new fixed-multiplicity/genus internal-dominance conjecture at its first nontrivial multiplicity beyond three, with explicit uniform injection, exact leaf counts and sharp asymptotic rarity. Its family is natural, not a contrived finite numerical slice, and old total-count results alone do not provide its classification.
